english.title: make unlawful use of an entrance / exit at a tramstop on the Croydon Tramlink system
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) at a tramstop, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TRAMSTOP..), on the Croydon Tramlink system

(A)_[entered by an exit where there was a notice indicating that it was to be used for exit only]_
(B)_[left by an entrance where there was a notice indicating that it was to be used for entrance only]_
(C)_[entered by an emergency exit otherwise than in an emergency or when directed to do so by an authorised person]_
(D)_[left by an emergency exit otherwise than in an emergency or when directed to do so by an authorised person]_
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 10(2) and 26 of the Croydon Tramlink Byelaws made under section 46 of the Croydon Tramlink Act 1994.
